source.transport: GitHub REST snapshots through the r.jina.ai public reader because direct GitHub egress and the configured 7900 proxy were unavailable
evidence_boundaries: Titles, bodies, open counts, comment counts, reactions, timestamps, draft state, and top-PR changed-file paths were read from the open-item snapshot.
Labels are almost unused upstream; only one labeled item was observed, so title prefixes, body/package names, and changed-file paths drive clustering.
Issue comments were not fetched; only comment counts are represented.
PR mergeability, conflict state, review approvals, and CI conclusions were not fetched and must be treated as unverified.
Author test claims in PR bodies are recorded as claims; this audit did not run package tests.
Direct GitHub egress was unavailable; the snapshot was obtained through a public read-only mirror, so panel-sync should refresh from GitHub before acting.

risk_levels.P0: Security exposure or broad irreversible harm; act first.
risk_levels.P1: Account safety, session/data loss, core workflow interruption, or a release-blocking compatibility failure.
risk_levels.P2: Material but scoped reliability or compatibility issue.

risk_signal_counts.method: Keyword signals across all open titles and bodies; counts overlap and are triage hints, not severity totals.

package_clusters.reason: New providers, generic feature requests, and titles without a registered package id.

package_cluster_tail.reason: The panel seed keeps the 40 largest clusters inline; panel-sync can hydrate the tail from the same snapshot.

priority_issues.title: providers-hub: the sign-in page's /paste takes a POST from any web page (no Origin check, no token)
priority_issues.reason: During the 15-minute loopback login window, any web page can POST attacker-controlled credentials to /paste; the user can then be signed in to the wrong account.

action.detail: Require a per-window URL token and same-origin POST, reject null origins, and add a cross-origin regression test.

priority_issues.title: opencode-lobster-auth 这个插件让网易给我封号了
priority_issues.reason: A user reports a NetEase account ban after using an installable plugin that is absent from this repository, leaving source provenance and request behavior unresolved.

action.detail: Request plugin source/version, request timeline, and the ban notice; hold any registry promotion until ban-risk evidence is reviewed.

priority_issues.title: [请求优化] antigravity被ban了，推测在多次预测/取消后产生429提示被ban
priority_issues.reason: The report links repeated 403 responses followed by 429 and account blocking to repeated prediction/cancel behavior; 31 comments indicate sustained user impact.

action.detail: Collect request counts, cancellation timestamps, response bodies, and ban notices; add cancellation/backoff guardrails after reproduction.

priority_issues.title: agy-cli: isolate agy home (--gemini-dir / --disable-telemetry), guard built-in tools, strip Claude Code CLI identity, and intercept in-band soft-ban notices
priority_issues.reason: Shared Gemini state and telemetry, built-in tool exposure, client identity leakage, and unclassified in-band soft-ban notices all increase account and data-exposure risk.

action.detail: Isolate agy state, disable telemetry, guard built-in tools, normalize client identity, and classify soft-ban notices as errors with tests.

priority_issues.title: Factory 0.1.56: Cowork built-in MCP tool declarations still receive content_policy_rejected on Magpie 0.1.4657
priority_issues.reason: Tool-free requests succeed while Cowork's built-in MCP declarations trigger content_policy_rejected, blocking the first turn and risking repeated policy violations.

action.detail: Bisect the built-in tool declarations on the same account and map policy rejection to a precise refusal without retry loops.

priority_issues.title: workbuddy: empty delta.tool_calls: [] splits reasoning into thousands of parts and freezes OpenCode Desktop 2.x
priority_issues.reason: Empty tool_calls frames fragment reasoning into thousands of persisted parts; 83 affected messages make session restore freeze on Windows OpenCode Desktop 2.x.

action.detail: Ignore empty tool_calls arrays, coalesce reasoning chunks, and add a session-restore regression with the reported part counts.

priority_issues.title: agy-cli 0.1.116: validateBody 无条件拦截 tool_result + assistant prefill tail，导致流中断后 Magpie 断点续传必死 400
priority_issues.reason: After an interrupted tool turn, Magpie's prefill resume is unconditionally rejected when history ends in tool_result plus assistant text, losing the live session and forcing clipped replay.

action.detail: Support or safely transform the prefill-tail shape, and add a resume test covering tool_result plus partial assistant text.

priority_issues.title: [zen-free] Dropping unknown tool calls as text ends autonomous DSH turns instead of allowing recovery
priority_issues.reason: Unknown tool calls are deleted, the finish reason is rewritten to stop, and an autonomous turn ends as a false success with no recoverable tool error.

action.detail: Preserve a recoverable tool error and stop rewriting malformed tool calls into a normal stop.

priority_issues.title: qoder-cn: chat returns 200 + keepalive only, never a single token (ideVersion sent empty)
priority_issues.reason: Qoder CN returns HTTP 200 and keepalives but no token, error, or finish reason; credentials and quota reads remain valid.

action.detail: Review PR #1253, which cancels the pending first-event read on watchdog timeout and returns a bounded 504.

priority_issues.title: qoder-cn: with DeepSeekRuntime (DSH) client — 200 + keepalive only, never a token (0.2.72, magpie 0.1.4746, Docker/Linux)
priority_issues.reason: The same keepalive-only symptom appears with DSH in Docker on Linux, so the Windows-only watchdog fix may not cover the full environment matrix.

action.detail: Cross-link #1204/#1220 and verify PR #1253 in the Linux container with request and gateway traces; close as duplicate only if the root cause matches.

priority_issues.title: zcode: ZCode 3.18 saves credentials as enc:v2: — decrypt() only reads enc:v1, so ZCode app's sign-in loses the ZCode session
priority_issues.reason: ZCode 3.18 stores all credential values as enc:v2, while the plugin only understands enc:v1; gift and trial models disappear despite an active desktop sign-in.

action.detail: Review PR #1358 as the canonical enc:v2 fix; consolidate or close overlapping PRs #1161/#1116/#1154 after comparison.

priority_issues.title: Copilot slots lapse after ~24h idle although the GitHub OAuth token is still valid
priority_issues.reason: Idle Copilot slots are marked expired even though refresh tokens remain valid; only the active account is renewed.

action.detail: Add a background refresh path for every signed-in slot and verify idle multi-account renewal.

priority_issues.title: trae: an enterprise sign-in's bare host is rejected, so every chat goes to the consumer gateway
priority_issues.reason: A valid enterprise SaaS JWT is rejected because traeHost does not normalize a bare hostname; enterprise models disappear and chats route to the consumer gateway.

action.detail: Normalize enterprise bare-host storage and add a SaaS catalog/chat regression.

priority_issues.title: [doubao-work] Windows 环境下非默认路径安装时启动崩溃 (0x80000003)
priority_issues.reason: Launching Doubao Work from a non-default Windows path exits with STATUS_BREAKPOINT and never opens the CDP port, blocking login and chat.

action.detail: Capture a crash dump and test the proposed launch-argument change on Windows custom-path installs before adopting it.

priority_issues.title: agy-cli (Windows): background quota refresh opens Google OAuth on transient token refresh failure at startup
priority_issues.reason: A background quota read can fall back to interactive Google OAuth on a transient refresh failure, opening a browser at startup without user intent.

action.detail: Suppress interactive OAuth for background quota work and retry the stored refresh token silently.

priority_prs.title: zcode 0.1.69: reads ZCode 3.18's enc:v2 sign-in (#1196)
priority_prs.reason: Directly fixes the current ZCode 3.18 credential format and restores app-backed sign-in.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author describes enc:v2 os/env key handling and test changes; CI and live matrix are unverified here.

priority_prs.title: qoder 0.2.72: cancel the first-event read on watchdog
priority_prs.reason: Small, targeted fix for silent HTTP 200 streams that never deliver a first event, including the reported qoder-cn keepalive-only failure.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author adds a regression that keeps the body reader cancellable by the watchdog; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: agy-cli 0.1.110: a standalone upstream status line is its HTTP error, not assistant text (#1416)
priority_prs.reason: Stops upstream 400/403 status banners from being returned as successful assistant text, restoring correct retry and refusal behavior.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author maps standalone status lines to HTTP errors and adds repeat-batch coverage; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: fix(catpaw): 手动粘贴 token 补 current-user 身份，多个粘贴账号不再互相覆盖
priority_prs.reason: Prevents a second manually pasted account from overwriting the first account's derived storage slot.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author reports current-user lookup plus fallback identity and 74+2 tests; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: codearts 0.3.23: a refused catalog read no longer signs an account out
priority_prs.reason: Separates an OfficeAce catalog credential refusal from the user's actual sign-in state, preventing false logout alarms.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author documents live multi-account reproduction and a focused fix; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: fix(agy-cli): read default Linux file-backed sign-in
priority_prs.reason: Restores quota access for headless/container Linux installs where agy writes a token file instead of using D-Bus keyring.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author adds default-Linux token-file tests; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: fix(agy-cli): fall back to default token file on macOS when Keychain item is missing
priority_prs.reason: Avoids false sign-in expiry on macOS when agy has a valid token file but no Keychain item.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author adds Keychain-not-found fallback coverage; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: agy-cli 0.1.117: recover from agy UNAUTHENTICATED (code 401) endings on a fresh process
priority_prs.reason: Recovers long-lived ACP sessions whose in-memory token cache goes stale after another process refreshes the token.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author describes fresh-process retry and repeat-batch coverage; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: agy-cli 0.1.117: isolate sibling branches sharing a conversationKey
priority_prs.reason: Prevents side chats and forks from colliding on one live ACP process, which causes 503 active-response errors and cache/session loss.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author adds sibling-branch regression coverage; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: agy-cli 0.1.113: preserve ACP sessions and support long MCP tool names
priority_prs.reason: Avoids dropping a live ACP session when tool_search grows tools mid-turn and supports long MCP tool names.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author combines two live-session fixes with targeted tests; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: agy-cli: preserve active context across suggestions, history forks and compaction
priority_prs.reason: Separates background suggestions from the live conversation and preserves alternate histories before replay budget clipping.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author adds conversation-key and repeat-batch coverage; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: agy-cli 0.1.117: preserve active DSH <available_skills> and workspace instructions when clipping >112 KiB replays
priority_prs.reason: Prevents long DSH sessions from losing workspace instructions and available skills during cold replay clipping.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author adds DSH replay-state coverage; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: autoclaw: proactively refresh token on 401/403 before failing
priority_prs.reason: Adds a single-flight refresh and retry path so a revoked but refreshable access token no longer strands an account in backoff.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author documents single-flight refresh, save-before-swap, and tests; CI is unverified here.

priority_prs.title: agent-console 1.3.11: keep following replies and queued turns active
priority_prs.reason: Fixes stream-follow scroll races and queued-turn handoff so a live reply does not appear to stop while content continues.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author adds deterministic Chromium and manager coverage; larger surface requires CI review.

priority_prs.title: autoclaw 0.2.26: remote-web panel login and startup isolation
priority_prs.reason: Adds CSRF-protected remote login, one-time tickets, bounded bodies, and startup isolation while preventing a panel port conflict from disabling both providers.
priority_prs.validation_claim: Author documents CSRF, state validation, ticket TTL, and startup isolation; CI is unverified here.

overlap_and_hold_clusters.reason: All four touch ZCode 3.18 credential decryption or Keychain prompting. Review #1358 first, compare platform coverage, then consolidate the remaining stack instead of merging overlapping implementations.
These changes overlap in packages/agy-cli/index.mjs and address related conversation-key, replay, and live-session behavior. Review in the listed order and require rebases after each merge.
Issue #1433 reports an account ban while PR #1209 would add a LobsterAI registry entry. Do not promote the entry until source provenance and ban-risk evidence are reviewed.
